The ball now bounces off the paddle, bricks and walls again. The cause was line 124 of `Gameplay.fs`, where the ball's starting velocity was set with `Entity.LinearVelocity @=`. In Nu's ImSim, `@=` is re-applied every frame, and `Gen.randomf` gives a new value each time. So each frame reset the ball to a new random downward velocity, which overwrote every bounce. That is why it kept heading down, passed through the paddle, and wobbled. I changed it to `.=`, so the velocity is set once when the ball is created. The paddle, wall and brick sensors and their bounce code were already correct and are unchanged. I checked the `@=`/`.=` semantics in Nu's `WorldImSim.fs`.
